plugins.name: wordpress-platform
plugins.description: WordPress platform fundamentals and operations: core architecture and hooks, coding and documentation standards, installation/migration/staging, multisite, content modeling (CPTs, taxonomies, meta), options and transients, database design with wpdb and custom tables, performance diagnosis and optimization, and security hardening (capabilities, sanitization, nonces, auth, backups).

plugins.name: wordpress-development
plugins.description: Building on WordPress: plugin development (foundations, lifecycle hooks, admin menus, settings pages, shortcodes, AJAX, cron, internationalization, WordPress.org release workflow), theme development (classic and block themes, template hierarchy, theme.json, patterns, Customizer, accessibility, theme review), and REST API integration (custom endpoints, controllers, schema, HTTP API clients, authentication, XML-RPC).

plugins.name: wordpress-content-sync
plugins.description: Bidirectional WordPress content synchronization over the WP REST API using Application Password auth. Pull posts/pages as local markdown, push approved content back as drafts, resolve categories/tags/CPT taxonomies, upload media, and manage SEO meta (Yoast/RankMath). Includes a reusable sync-posts.sh script.

plugins.name: mql5-development
plugins.description: End-to-end MQL5 Expert Advisor development: EA architecture (5-layer wiring, OnTick, IsNewBar), risk engine (position sizing, drawdown guards, prop firm rules), signal generation (SMC/ICT, indicators, multi-timeframe confluence), market regime detection (trend/range, volatility, session, news filters), and trade lifecycle management (trailing stops, breakeven, partial closes, pyramiding).

plugins.name: metatrader-platform
plugins.description: MetaTrader 4/5 platform operations, Python API integration, and HTTP API bridge usage. Covers terminal installation and configuration (Windows/macOS/Linux), SSL/certificate management, 2FA/TOTP setup, MetaTrader5 Python package workflows, mt5-httpapi bridge for REST-based account/symbol/trade data, and platform automation scripts.

plugins.name: metatrader-research
plugins.description: Backtesting methodology and trading performance analytics for MetaTrader strategies. Covers MT5 Strategy Tester configuration, walk-forward and Monte Carlo analysis, overfitting detection, performance metric computation (Sharpe, Calmar, Profit Factor, drawdown), Python-based pandas evaluation pipelines, imported HTML report parsing, and experiment tracking for EA variants.

plugins.name: mt5-httpapi
plugins.description: MetaTrader 5 trading via REST for a running mt5-httpapi bridge — market data, orders, positions, history, and server-side technical analysis.

plugins.name: mql-developer
plugins.description: Comprehensive MQL4/MQL5 development reference for MetaTrader 4 and 5: language syntax for both dialects, OOP and EA architecture patterns, order/position and risk operations, custom indicators and UI panels, WebRequest/REST/JSON external communication, Strategy Tester and walk-forward backtesting, code protection and licensing, and MQL4-to-MQL5 migration. Vendored verbatim from ThomasPraun/mql-developer.

plugins.name: trading-fundamentals
plugins.description: Forex macroeconomic fundamentals reference. Interprets CPI, GDP, NFP, PMI, rate decisions, employment, trade balance, current account, housing, wages, and confidence/survey releases across USD, EUR, GBP, GER, JPY, CAD, AUD, NZD, CHF, and CNY, with trading context and high-value release ranking per currency.

plugins.name: trading-web-systems
plugins.description: Elite TypeScript/React fintech and trading systems engineering: decimal-safe money arithmetic, trading metric implementations (Sharpe, Calmar, Drawdown, Profit Factor), real-time WebSocket market data feeds on Cloudflare Durable Objects, live-price React hooks, trading dashboard UI (PriceTicker, OrderBook), and OHLCV ingestion pipelines.

plugins.name: pskoett-ai-skills
plugins.description: Two-loop skill pipeline for Claude Code. Inner loop (plan-interview, intent-framed-agent, context-surfing, verify-gate, self-healing, simplify-and-harden) catches failures in-session — including active runtime recovery via self-healing when a command, test, build, helper, env, or external service fails mid-task. Outer loop (learning-aggregator, harness-updater, eval-creator, pre-flight-check) captures recurring patterns, promotes them to CLAUDE.md as permanent rules, and turns failures into regression tests. The harness gets stronger with every cycle.

plugins.name: graphify
plugins.description: Turn a codebase, docs, papers, images or videos into a queryable knowledge graph (graph.html, graph.json, GRAPH_REPORT.md) with /graphify, plus query/path/explain tools. Wraps the upstream graphify skill without its PreToolUse hooks. Requires the graphifyy Python package (uv tool install graphifyy).

plugins.name: codegraph
plugins.description: CodeGraph MCP server: a pre-indexed, local code knowledge graph that answers code questions in one codegraph_explore call (symbols, verbatim source, call paths). Wraps the upstream MCP config without its prompt hook. Requires the codegraph CLI (npm i -g @colbymchenry/codegraph) and codegraph init per project.
